metadata.dcterms:title: Mutant knots and intersection graphs
metadata.dcterms:creator: ∗, S. V. Chmutov
†, S. K. Lando
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We prove that if a ﬁnite order knot invariant does not disting uish mutant knots, then the corresponding weight system depends on the interse ction graph of a chord diagram rather than on the diagram itself. The convers e statement is easy and well known. We discuss relationship between our res ults and certain Lie algebra weight systems.
